what.text: This page follows refugees from Hungary in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2055 Hungarian refugees, and Canada hosted 75.9% of them.
After Canada, the largest hosts are Germany, Sweden and France.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Hungary, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1965 to 1970, 1988 to 1994 and 2016 to 2021, among others.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1965 at 3270 refugees, and the figure fell to a low in 1976.
The figure was at its highest, 5767, at the end of 1990.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
